Keep writes an inline data image with its payload

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<p>Before <img src=\"data:image/png;base64,AAAA\" alt=\"icon\"> after</p>", options = ConversionOptions$from_json(jsonlite::toJSON(list("inline_data_media" = "keep"), auto_unbox = TRUE)))
print(result$content)
```
